definitions.supported_numeric: Any source-evidenced numeric metric, including qualified years, criterion groups, conditional quotas or auxiliary metrics; NOT a complete funnel.
definitions.core_admissions: At least one non-null field among places,applications,offers,acceptances,names placed,list remaining,actual admissions. Unknown-year rows excluded. Accepted is not actual admission.
definitions.strict: Explicitly dated and cohort matched core evidence; no user-report-unverified quality. Further per-metric conflicts/denominator tests apply to comparable ratios.
definitions.gaps: Only absent years between this school oldest/latest observed core year. Earlier/later historical coverage remains unresolved, not implicitly absent.
definitions.site_attempted: Bounded public own-site navigation or permission/retrieval attempts, NOT exhaustive historical search. No-new-found is not proof a notice does not exist.
definitions.source_omission: Missing observation status applies to the reviewed source edition only, not all years for a school.
